SUBNet subcontracting opportunities

SBA's SUBNet (subcontracting network) helps large federal prime contractors find small subcontractors.

Notice: To post new subcontracting opportunities in SUBNet, please email subcontracting@sba.gov for the information needed.

Small businesses can browse the listing below to find subcontracting opportunities. You can filter the listing by state or keyword, or sort the listing by clicking a column header. Please direct questions to the posted point of contact for the opportunity, not SBA. Any posts meant only to promote your small business will be removed.
